description: New Lvl3 under H4.2, from D009 (C0094, C0095, C0099): a zero-cost accuracy-per-step lever. On tip E031, change only the Newton-Schulz polynomial coefficients. Replace the fixed airbench quintic (a, b, c) = (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315) with Polar-Express-style per-iteration coefficients at the same iteration count. First confirm the current count in the code; E025's notes suggest 3. Keep the same pre-normalization, including the small safety factor, and keep bf16. Iteration count, momentum, lr, schedule and the stacked bmm grouping stay the same. Verify on a random 704x6336 matrix that the singular values after NS fall in [0.7, 1.2] before running.
